function load($teamId) {
    $players = $this->repository->activePlayersForTeam($teamId);

    $players = array_filter($players, fn($p) => $p['tid'] === $teamId);
    $players = array_filter($players, fn($p) => $p['injured'] === 0);
    return $players;
}
